// Package unformatted holds the shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the original still judges: a guard split across
// lines, an assertion in a case split across lines, and doubled parentheses around the switched variable.
package unformatted

import "fmt"

func split(x interface{}) {
	switch x.(
		type) {
	case int:
		fmt.Println(x.(
			int))
	}
}

func splitBeforeTheDot(x interface{}) {
	switch x.
		(type) {
	case string:
		fmt.Println(x.
			(string))
	}
}

func doubled(x interface{}) {
	switch ((x)).(type) {
	case int:
		fmt.Println(x.(int))
	}
}
